description: This file defines the 'compact' package related to language tags, including the Tag struct, methods for creating and manipulating language tags, and functions for identifying and processing language tag components based on the BCP 47 standard.

classes.name: Tag
classes.description: Represents a BCP 47 language tag, used to specify language or locale instances.

methods.name: Make
methods.description: Creates a compact Tag from a fully specified internal language Tag.

methods.name: Tag
methods.description: Returns an internal language Tag version of this tag.

methods.name: IsCompact
methods.description: Reports whether this tag is fully defined in terms of ID.

methods.name: MayHaveVariants
methods.description: Indicates if a tag may have variants.

methods.name: MayHaveExtensions
methods.description: Indicates if a tag may have extensions.

methods.name: IsRoot
methods.description: Checks if the tag is equal to 'und' (undefined).

methods.name: Parent
methods.description: Returns the CLDR parent of the tag.

methods.name: LanguageTag
methods.description: Returns the tag stripped of regional and variant indicators.

methods.name: RegionalTag
methods.description: Returns the regional variant of the tag.

methods.name: FromTag
methods.description: Reports the closest matching ID for an internal language Tag.
